title: Human whole blood infected with Plamsmodium falciparum Transcriptome
description: Whole blood collected from children aged 0-14 in Bandiagara, Mali, preserved in Paxgene RNA preservative. This study aims to identify gene expression associated with the parasitemia of the infection and the age of the child at the time of the infection.
